title: A holder's settings for one role (settings/roles/<role>/holder.json in the agent's store)
description: agent-fabric ADR-060 §5 rule 8: who this holder is while it holds the role — the locale it renders in and the facts of its deployment. Installed by the parent only (rule 3); checked by tools/fabric/addenda_check.py at install and at render.

locale.description: The locale whose renderings the launcher chooses (identities/roles/<role>/locale/<locale>/, identities/prompt/locale/<locale>/); en for English.

timezone.description: An IANA zone name, the deployment's (not the language's).

country.description: The country the holder's web search answers as, lower-case ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.
